03290 Ya`aqob {yah-ak-obe'}

源自 SNH06117; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Jacob 349; 349

雅各 = "抓住腳後跟的人" 或 "取代者"
1) 以撒之子, 亞伯拉罕之孫, 及以色列十二支派的族長之祖
record.edic_text:
03290 Ya`aqob {yah-ak-obe'}

from 06117;; n pr m

AV - Jacob 349; 349

Jacob = "heel holder" or "supplanter"
1) son of Isaac, grandson of Abraham, and father of the 12 patriarchs
   of the tribes of Israel
